mapper.select: SELECT l.task_id, t.req_id, l.from_column, l.to_column, l.detail, l.created_at FROM task_log l LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'move' AND l.created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY l.task_id, l.created_at, l.id
SELECT id, req_id, title, priority, board_column, created_at, completed_at, req_doc_id FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id, d.req_id, d.title, d.status, d.created_at, MIN(t.created_at) AS first_task_at, COUNT(t.id) AS task_count FROM requirement_doc d LEFT JOIN task t ON t.req_doc_id = d.id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} GROUP BY d.id, d.req_id, d.title, d.status, d.created_at
